verdict.rationale: Sentry ships AI agent tracing and LLM observability, so evaluation scorers are a fair axis for it. However, the evidence only documents tracing, conversation replay, cost and token dashboards, and custom dashboard widgets. Nothing shows evaluations, datasets, or user-defined code-based scorers or metrics. Custom span-based dashboard widgets are an adjacent feature and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can write custom code-based scorers and metrics for my evaluations
